_comment: FusedSensorNet (modelblaster's fused_full): vision CNN + ToF depth conv + 3-layer LSTM + head, three inputs (front_grey 1x1x60x90, tof_cross 1x4x8x8, lowdim 1x21). One coarse tile — at ~3-5 ms whole-network there is nothing to gain from splitting, and the LSTM tail is sequential anyway. Precision differs per backend by necessity, not preference: the DSP is int8-only and composed the quantized graph; the CPU op package rejects that graph's Reshape config at int8 but takes the fp32 build. HTA rejects on Transpose. Converted by flow_c from modelblaster's own module and calibrated with its get_calibration_samples().
